email.subject: Renewal request — Riverside Manufacturing Co. policy SBA-4471902
email.body:
Good morning,

Please prepare the renewal quotation for Riverside Manufacturing Co. policy SBA-4471902, currently expiring on 08/01/2026. We would like to keep the same effective date of 08/01/2025 for the renewal term and review any updated pricing, forms, or underwriting requirements.

Please send the renewal proposal and declarations when available. Thank you.

Karen Delgado
Riverside Manufacturing Co.

Correction: the total premium should read slightly lower than the attached invoice; we're reconciling.

Karen Delgado
Riverside Manufacturing Co.

CONFIDENTIALITY NOTICE: This message and any attachments are intended solely for the addressee and may contain confidential information.
